hero.headline: Big smiles. Big hustle. One team.
hero.summary: The third grade girls brought energy, teamwork and sportsmanship to a two-game weekend against St. Gregory and OLPH St. Catherine.

games.headline: Energy from the opening tip
games.recap: St. Augustine opened the weekend against St. Gregory with active defense, confident ball movement and teammates cheering every possession. The Eagles kept working from the opening tip to the final whistle.

games.headline: Together through every possession
games.recap: Against OLPH St. Catherine, the Eagles stayed connected. Players listened in the huddle, brought the ball up with their heads up and supported one another through every possession.

spotlight.title: Team Spotlight
spotlight.name: Third Grade Girls
spotlight.body: This weekend’s spotlight belongs to the whole team. The players hustled on both ends, celebrated one another and showed sportsmanship from warm-ups through the final whistle.

announcements.title: Happy Thanksgiving!
announcements.body: Thursday’s practice is cancelled for Thanksgiving. Happy Thanksgiving to everyone!

announcements.title: Share a photo or shout-out
announcements.body: Have a photo to share or a shout-out for a teammate? Send it to the coaches and we will feature it in the next issue.

newsletter.title: Weekend Edition
newsletter.subtitle: St. Gregory + OLPH St. Catherine • November 21–22, 2026
newsletter.welcome: Our third grade girls played two games over the weekend, and the best part of the afternoon had nothing to do with the scoreboard. From warm-ups to the final whistle, they hustled, cheered each other on and had a great time playing together.
newsletter.thanks: Thank you to the families, coaches and volunteers who came out to support the team. Your cheers carried through the gym.
values: Teamwork: players cheered for each other on every possession.
Effort: hustle on both ends of the court.
Sportsmanship: kind words and high fives, win or lose.
